item.title: Rep. Zoe Lofgren presents $1.2 million check to fund repairs to Watsonville veterans building
item.description: The 92-year-old Veterans Memorial Building on East Lake Avenue in Watsonville is set to receive what many veterans have called much-needed fixes.

item.title: Prosecutors stand by former Black Panther’s conviction but accuse judge of misconduct when he prosecuted the case
item.description: Al-Amin died in prison in November.

item.title: Warriors share results of Steph Curry’s MRI on ailing right knee
item.description: Steph Curry will miss his sixth consecutive game with runner's knee

item.title: Santa Cruz, Bay Area to get a brief break before more weekend rain arrives
item.description: Next up comes a fourth system, a bit different from the previous storms but traveling a similar path from the north. That storm is set to arrive in the North Bay sometime about midday Saturday and is likely to spread through the region on Sunday, National Weather Service meteorologist Rachel Kennedy said. For Monday, Kennedy said the entire region should anticipate downfalls.

item.title: Photo | Crane towers over UC Santa Cruz’s Kresge College as rebuild continues
item.description: A towering construction crane at UC Santa Cruz’s Kresge College was dismantled recently. The crane was being used in the near total rebuilding of the college, which was founded in the early 1970s and according to a press release from UCSC, was designed with “concepts of collaboration and participatory democracy at the core of its identity.”

item.title: Guest Commentary | Can we have political joy in Santa Cruz?
item.description: "We have an opportunity to bring the joy I have seen at Water and Ocean streets during our collective repudiation of Trumpian perfidy, to our local scene, and put an immediate stop to the greed and despoilment of our community landscape," writes Chris Krohn in a Guest Commentary.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: His family says he spent his final days with loved ones.

item.title: Ex-Pittsburg High QB Jaden Rashada settles breach of contract suit over failed $14M NIL deal
item.description: Rashada, a redshirt junior with Mississippi State, his fourth college since leaving Pittsburg High, was seeking at least $10 million in his complaint against former Florida coach Billy Napier, among others.

item.title: Warriors routed by Celtics in Kristaps Porzingis’ debut with Golden State
item.description: The Warriors were outscored 17-2 during Porzingis' first stretch of playing time since the Warriors acquired him from Atlanta.

item.title: County qualifies three boys soccer teams for CCS playoffs
item.description: Santa Cruz County advanced three high school boys soccer teams -- up one from last season with the re-emergence of Watsonville -- for the 2026 Central Coast Section playoffs.
